messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I opened a tiny PR to resolve a couple of naming/lint nits in kvcache. Mostly renames and a one-line formatting fix. Plan to merge in tomorrow's merge window if everything looks ok.
Cheng: @Maya can you paste the diff for the rename? I want to make sure it doesn't clash with the batching changes I'm working on.
Maya: sure — main change is `ctx` -> `requestCtx` in kvcache.go to reduce ambiguity with callsite ctxs. Also fixed `go vet` warning in cache_test. snippet:```diff
- func getFromCache(ctx context.Context, key string) (*Entry, error) {
+ func getFromCache(requestCtx context.Context, key string) (*Entry, error) {
```
Maya: It's intentionally small, no logic changes. I ran unit tests locally.
Cheng: looks safe from a quick skim. My batching branch touches kvcache.ReadHotPrefix but not that function, so shouldn't conflict. I'll give a full review tomorrow morning.
CI Bot: build/linters failed on commit 34a7c2 — formatting issue in kvcache/helper.go (gofmt mismatch).
Maya: thanks CI. Pushed a tiny fmt fix in 34a7c2 -> 5b9f1d, should be green now.
CI Bot: build/linters passed on commit 5b9f1d.
Oliver: @Maya I can take an approval if Cheng is busy. Quick question — did you update any exported symbols?
Maya: no exported API changes. Only internal func param rename and a test var rename.
Sam: :thumbsup: if everything's internal I'm fine with fast-track merge.
Cheng: I'm +1 pending CI — will re-check tomorrow AM but no objections.
Leo: FYI merge window is 09:00 UTC tomorrow. If you plan to merge during the window, please add the PR to the merge board and ping #eng-merge.
Maya: will do. Adding to merge board now and will ping the channel once CI stays green. Thank you all.
Oliver: nice, appreciate the quick cleanup.
Maya: one small note for reviewers — if you spot any other ambiguous `ctx` usages in that package, feel free to flag them and I'll bundle follow-ups into next tiny PR.
Cheng: good idea. I'll scan and add comments if I see more.
Maya: thanks everyone :)
